answer: A tundra of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the wander of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
